overview.location: Hebron, Boone County, Kentucky — across the Ohio River from Cincinnati, Ohio. Despite the 'Cincinnati' name, CVG is in KENTUCKY, not Ohio (a common traveler mix-up).
overview.passengerVolume: 8,971,128 passengers in 2025 (down 2.62% from the 2024 record of ~9.2 million, the most in 15 years)
overview.cargoVolume: 1,703,828 tons in 2025 — ranked 5th busiest U.S. airport by cargo and among the top cargo airports in the world. Home to Amazon Air's primary global hub and a DHL Americas hub.
overview.distinction: Kentucky's busiest airport and one of North America's largest cargo airports. Amazon Air's primary hub (opened 2017 on ~1,129 acres, 3 million sq ft sort facility) and DHL's Americas hub (since 1984) sit on the airfield. Former Delta Air Lines mega-hub (600+ daily flights in 2005) — today Delta remains the largest passenger carrier (~24% share in 2025) alongside a growing low-cost mix (Frontier, Allegiant, Breeze, Southwest).
overview.operator: Kenton County Airport Board (CVG Airport Authority)
overview.dominantAirline: Delta Air Lines (largest passenger carrier, ~24% of 2025 passengers; former hub — focus-city status ended 2021)
overview.nonstopDestinations: 50+ nonstop passenger destinations in North America and Europe
overview.founded: 1947 (site first used as an Army Air Corps field in 1944)
overview.metroAccess: No rail. TANK Route 2X 'Airporter' bus links CVG to downtown Cincinnati; departs Ground Transport East (Public Transit) on the Baggage Claim level.
overview.peopleMover: Underground walkway and automated people mover connect the main terminal to Concourses A and B (the walkway appears in the film Rain Man).

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse A
terminals.status: Active — 23 gates. Reached from the main terminal via the underground walkway / people mover.
airlines: verify per-concourse airline assignments on cvgairport.com/flights
terminals.notes: The Club CVG lounge is between Gates A8 and A10. Service animal relief area (SARA) near Gate A18.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse B
terminals.status: Active — 28 gates. International arrivals without pre-clearance are processed here.
airlines: verify per-concourse airline assignments on cvgairport.com/flights
terminals.notes: Delta Sky Club near Gate B14 (Level 3). Escape Lounge (Centurion Studio Partner) relocated to a larger space in Concourse B in 2026. Service animal relief area near Gate B13. Charley Harper artwork in the food court.

Hotel courtesy shuttles from Ground Transport West
Economy Lot / ValuPark shuttles (BusGenius live tracking)

peopleMover.description: Automated people mover and underground walkway linking the main terminal to Concourses A and B
peopleMover.note: Single terminal with two concourses — no terminal-to-terminal shuttle needed.

groundTransportZones.east: Ground Transport East (Baggage Claim level): Uber/Lyft, zTrip taxi, TANK bus (Public Transit), private van/car/limousine
groundTransportZones.west: Ground Transport West (Baggage Claim level): ALL hotel courtesy shuttles and the Rental Car Center. Partner lot instructions (Hilton, Holiday Inn) specify Ground Transport West, Zone 3.
groundTransportZones.note: Neither zone is at the terminal curbfront — follow signs from Baggage Claim.

tankBus.fare: $2 local cash fare; TANK 1-Day Pass $4; Metro/TANK 1-Day Pass $5 (verify whether 2X carries an express surcharge)
tankBus.accessFromTerminal: Baggage Claim level — follow signs to Ground Transport East, then Public Transit
tankBus.note: Only public transit to CVG. Check tankbus.org for the current 2X timetable.

taxi.pickup: Ground Transport East, Baggage Claim level
taxi.providers: zTrip (official airport taxi; wheelchair-accessible vehicles available)
taxi.note: Fares not published by the airport — confirm with zTrip.

rideshare.pickupLocation: Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level (not the terminal curb)
rideshare.note: Follow signs from Baggage Claim to Ground Transport East; the app will confirm the exact pickup spot.

rentalCars.location: Rental Car Center, part of the CVG Terminal — 3057 Terminal Drive, Hebron, KY 41048. Walk from Baggage Claim via Ground Transport West signage; no shuttle needed.
rentalCars.note: No personal-vehicle parking at the Rental Car Center — park in CVG parking first.

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: All hotel courtesy shuttles pick up at Ground Transport West (Baggage Claim level). Most airport hotels are in Erlanger (Airport Exchange Blvd) and Florence (Turfway Road / Meijer Dr / Vandercar Way). The DoubleTree is listed on the airport's contact page at (859) 371-6166.

parkingRates: On-airport (per day): Economy Lot $10, ValuPark $12, Terminal Garage $23, Terminal Garage Premium Reserved $27 (prepaid only), Valet $35. Credit cards only — no cash. Off-site via Triply: hotel park-and-fly lots in Florence and Erlanger from ~$5.15/day with free shuttle.

economyLot.name: CVG Economy Lot
economyLot.connection: Shuttle every 15 minutes; 24/7 pickup and drop-off at shelters; live tracking via BusGenius

valuPark.name: CVG ValuPark
valuPark.connection: 24/7 continuous vehicle pickup and drop-off with luggage assistance; BusGenius tracking

terminalGarage.name: CVG Terminal Garage
terminalGarage.features: Adjacent to the terminal. Credit card only. 8 EV charging stations on Level D, Row 30.

terminalGaragePremiumReserved.name: CVG Terminal Garage — Premium Reserved
terminalGaragePremiumReserved.features: Guaranteed space on Level C, Rows 28-30. Prepaid reservation only.

valetParking.name: CVG Valet Parking
valetParking.location: Follow signs for Arrivals, then Valet, from the Baggage Claim level

cellPhoneLot.name: Cell Phone Lot
cellPhoneLot.location: On the right as you approach the terminal
cellPhoneLot.rules: For waiting to pick up arriving passengers; time limits not published

locations: Terminal Garage — Level D, Row 30 (8 stations)
evCharging.cost: No extra fees (standard parking rate applies)

parkingAdvantageProgram.name: Parking Advantage Program
parkingAdvantageProgram.status: Closed to new members as of 2026-10-13; existing members still earn
parkingAdvantageProgram.earning: Per paid day: Valet 30 pts, Terminal Garage 20 pts, ValuPark 10 pts, Economy 10 pts
parkingAdvantageProgram.note: Not usable with Premium Reserved reservations. Points expire after 1 year of inactivity.

onAirportParking.accessibleParking: Facilities are described as handicap accessible; specific space counts and any disabled-veteran exemption are not published — verify with CVG Parking.
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: Credit cards only — cash not accepted. Reserved spaces require prepayment.
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Terminal Garage and Valet → walk to terminal. Economy Lot and ValuPark → shuttle.

parkingLots.name: Hyatt Place Cincinnati Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, every 30 minutes. Check in at the front desk before leaving your car. On return, collect bags and call (859) 647-1170 for pickup.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel park-and-fly lot about 5 minutes' drive from CVG with a complimentary, ADA-accessible 24/7 shuttle. Easy highway access toward the Ark Encounter, Creation Museum and downtown Cincinnati stadiums.
parkingLots.notes: Lowest sellable rate at CVG on 2026-10-13 ($36.03 for a 6-night Nov 2-8 stay, 7 billed days). 24/7 shuttle makes it safe for 5-6 AM departures.

parkingLots.name: Quality Inn & Suites
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 5:00 AM-12:00 AM, every 30 minutes on the hour; door-to-door, on-demand pickups within shuttle hours. No shuttle midnight-5 AM. Call (859) 746-0300 from the airport; allow 20-30 minutes.
parkingLots.overview: Closest Triply lot to CVG on Airport Exchange Blvd in Erlanger. Free shuttle with online reservation and no extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks or large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: Allow at least 30 minutes for check-in before your shuttle. No overnight shuttle (12-5 AM) — late-night arrivals need another ride. Good pick for oversized vehicles.

parkingLots.name: Holiday Inn Cincinnati Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, every 30 minutes. Register your vehicle at the front desk via QR code and hang the placard on your mirror. On return, call (859) 746-5611; pickup at Ground Transport West, Zone 3.
parkingLots.overview: Erlanger hotel lot about 7 minutes (2.5 mi) from CVG with a spacious, well-lit, camera-monitored self-park lot and round-the-clock shuttle.
parkingLots.notes: Shuttle return line is (859) 746-5611 (different from the main number). Quoted $38.46 total for Nov 2-8.

parkingLots.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 6:30 AM-11:00 PM, every 30 minutes on the hour; on-demand pickups within those hours by calling (859) 817-0337. No shuttle 11 PM-6:30 AM.
parkingLots.overview: Florence hotel lot minutes from CVG with free shuttle on every online reservation, a 24/7 front desk and surveillance-monitored parking. No extra charge for full-size vans, pickups or large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: Allow 30 minutes for check-in. Shuttle does not run 11 PM-6:30 AM, so not ideal for 6 AM departures. Bring your own child car seat — shuttle rides are denied without proper seating.

parkingLots.name: Hilton Cincinnati Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24 hours; departs the hotel on the hour and half-hour, pickups on demand. From the airport, call (859) 371-4400 after baggage claim and wait at Ground Transport West, Zone 3; allow up to 30 minutes.
parkingLots.overview: Full-service Hilton on Turfway Road in Florence, ~10 minutes from CVG and ~10 miles from downtown Cincinnati. No hotel room required to park. Near Turfway Park.
parkingLots.notes: Display the front-desk dashboard sticker or risk towing; do not park in the Rafferty's lot. Shuttle cannot take mobility scooters. 18-wheelers prohibited. Quoted $50.40 total (incl. tax) for Nov 2-8.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Economy Lot shuttle every 15 minutes, ValuPark continuous 24/7 pickup with luggage help; both trackable live on BusGenius. Off-site: all Triply partner lots are hotel lots with free shuttles that pick up at Ground Transport West (Baggage Claim level) — call the hotel after you collect bags. Hyatt Place, Holiday Inn Cincinnati Airport and Hilton run 24/7; Quality Inn & Suites (5 AM-12 AM) and Holiday Inn Express & Suites (6:30 AM-11 PM) do not run overnight.
distanceFromCity: About 13 miles southwest of downtown Cincinnati across the Ohio River (~20-25 min by car via I-275/I-71/75) — verify exact mileage. Located in Hebron, Boone County, Kentucky.

keyDistances.toDowntownCincinnati: ~13 miles, ~20-25 min by car; TANK 2X bus
keyDistances.toFlorenceKY: ~3 miles (Triply lots: Hyatt Place, Holiday Inn Express & Suites, Hilton)
keyDistances.toErlangerKY: ~2 miles (Triply lots: Quality Inn & Suites, Holiday Inn Cincinnati Airport)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: Every Triply CVG lot sits 2-3 miles from the terminal in the Erlanger/Florence hotel corridor, so shuttle rides are short; three of five run 24/7.

construction2026.status: No major 2026 terminal or parking construction confirmed on cvgairport.com as of 2026-10-13 — verify current traffic alerts before travel.
projects: 2050 Master Plan Update (completed March 2021) guides future terminal, parking and cargo development.
Hangar Row development (~$20M, RAISE grant funded) — airside, not passenger-facing.
Periodic Airport Access Road (KY 212) resurfacing with overnight single-lane closures (8 PM-6 AM) — date unverified.
construction2026.travelImpact: No parking facility closures identified. Check cvgairport.com alerts (e.g., Concourse B elevator notices) before travel.

standardWaitTimes.average: Airport advises allowing at least 30 minutes for screening
standardWaitTimes.peakHours: Early-morning departure bank (checkpoint opens 3:30 AM) — verify
standardWaitTimes.tips: Single central checkpoint feeds both concourses.

arrivalRecommendation.domestic: At least 2 hours before departure (airport guidance)
arrivalRecommendation.holidays: 2.5-3 hours around Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring break

luggageStorage.onSite: verify — no luggage storage service listed on cvgairport.com

petFacilities.note: Source: cvgairport.com/accessibility. A sensory space for neurodivergent travelers is also available.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Summer (June-August), spring break, Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Bengals home games and Cincinnati events add weekend demand.

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid subtropical/continental transition: hot, humid summers and cold winters with periodic snow and ice.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Winter snow and freezing rain (December-February); summer thunderstorms (June-August); morning fog in the Ohio River valley.
weatherPatterns.winterNote: Ice storms can slow drives on I-275 and hotel shuttle runs — leave extra time and check flight status.
weatherPatterns.note: Off-site hotel lots are uncovered; bring a scraper in winter.

parkSleepFly.description: Hotel + parking + shuttle combos in the Erlanger and Florence hotel corridors 2-3 miles from CVG. Triply sells parking-only at the hotels below; room packages are booked with the hotel.
parkSleepFly.priceRange: Parking-only via Triply from ~$5.15/day (2026-10-13 quote); room package pricing — verify with hotel

popularHotels.name: Quality Inn & Suites
popularHotels.highlight: Breakfast included; closest lot; no oversize fee.

tankBusRoundTrip.costPerPersonRoundTrip: $4 (2 x $2 local cash fare — verify 2X fare)
tankBusRoundTrip.note: Only practical for downtown Cincinnati travelers.

savingsComparison.keyDifference: CVG's own Economy Lot is already cheap at $10/day, but Triply's Florence/Erlanger hotel lots run ~$5-7/day all-in — roughly half the Economy Lot and 69-78% less than the $23/day Terminal Garage.

uniqueFeatures.kentuckyNotOhio: CVG is in Hebron, Kentucky — not Ohio — even though it is Cincinnati's main airport. The Ohio River separates the airport from the city.
uniqueFeatures.amazonAirHub: Amazon Air's primary hub opened at CVG in 2017 on ~1,129 acres with a 3 million sq ft sort center and parking for 100+ aircraft.
uniqueFeatures.dhlHub: DHL has run its Americas hub at CVG since 1984, with about 2,500 employees on site.
uniqueFeatures.cargoGiant: 1.7 million tons of cargo in 2025 — 5th busiest U.S. airport by cargo.
uniqueFeatures.deltaLegacy: CVG was Delta's second-largest hub (600+ daily flights in 2005) and home of Comair until 2012. Delta remains the largest passenger carrier today.
uniqueFeatures.rainManWalkway: The underground walkway between the terminal and concourses appears in the film Rain Man.
uniqueFeatures.art: Five Winold Reiss Art Deco mosaic murals from Cincinnati Union Terminal and Charley Harper artwork in Concourse B.

emergencyContacts.emergency: 911 — state you are at CVG Airport
